address: 7 Mill Street, Chagford, TQ13 8AW, United Kingdom
bio: Set just off the main square of a charming Dartmoor stannary town, this 200-year-old inn still brims with life today, thanks to its owners’ warm hospitality. The interior looks as fresh as ever with its modern-rustic style, while the kitchen team don’t reinvent the wheel but instead focus on skilled classical dishes that overflow with flavour and generosity. The menu proudly namechecks Devon suppliers in the likes of roasted Batworthy Farm chicken supreme with Jersey Royals, asparagus and mushroom butter sauce. Boldly furnished bedrooms are ideal for weary travellers.
